Who We Are / من نحن

Algerian Expertise in Dry Mortar

SacaMix is an Algerian company specialized in high-quality dry mortar solutions for construction and plastering applications.

Our products are designed to provide efficiency, consistency, and ease of use on every project — helping contractors and builders achieve professional results with less effort.
